## Mimecast Security Events Dashboard
---

This workbook gives email security and SOC teams one place to monitor Mimecast security events ingested into Microsoft Sentinel through the Mimecast Security Events (CCF) connector. It shows email gateway activity and outcomes, Targeted Threat Protection results for URLs, attachments and impersonation attempts, and audit events, so analysts can see what Mimecast is allowing, holding and rejecting and where to investigate first.

**What's inside**
- **Overview**: total events, events by type and event volume over time
- **Email Security**: log types, outcomes, direction, TLS usage, top sender domains, rejections and attachment protection
- **Targeted Threat Protection**: URL protection actions and categories, impersonation protection definitions and detailed events
- **Audit and Authentication**: audit events by type and category, plus the latest audit activity

**Data source:** `MimecastEvents_CL`. Each event is counted once, by its event ID. The Time Range and Event Type filters below apply to every panel.

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| summarize Events = count()
content.title: Total Events

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| summarize Events = count() by mimecastEventType
content.title: Events by Type

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| summarize Events = count() by mimecastEventType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Events Over Time by Type

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType in ("seg_cg", "email_ttp_ap")
| summarize Events = count() by mimecastLogtype
| order by Events desc
content.title: Email Log Types

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType == "seg_cg"
| extend Action = tostring(Body.action)
| extend Outcome = case(Action == "Acc", "Accepted", Action == "Rej", "Rejected", isempty(Action), "Not applicable", Action)
| summarize Events = count() by Outcome
content.title: Email Outcome

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType in ("seg_cg", "email_ttp_ap")
| extend Route = tostring(Body.route)
| where isnotempty(Route)
| summarize Events = count() by Route
content.title: Email Direction (Route)

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastLogtype == "email_receipt"
| extend TlsVersion = iff(tostring(Body.tlsUsed) == "true", tostring(Body.tlsVersion), "No TLS")
| summarize Events = count() by TlsVersion
content.title: TLS Usage on Received Email

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType in ("seg_cg", "email_ttp_ap")
| extend SenderDomain = tostring(Body.senderDomain)
| where isnotempty(SenderDomain)
| summarize Events = count() by SenderDomain
| top 10 by Events desc
content.title: Top Sender Domains

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastLogtype == "email_spam"
| extend RejectionType = tostring(Body.rejectionType), RejectionCode = tostring(Body.rejectionCode)
| summarize Events = count() by RejectionType, RejectionCode
| order by Events desc
content.title: Rejections by Type and Code

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType in ("email_ttp_ap", "ttp_attachment")
| extend FileExtension = coalesce(tostring(Body.fileExtension), tostring(Body.fileType)), Outcome = coalesce(tostring(Body.result), tostring(Body.scanResults), mimecastSubtype)
| summarize Events = count() by FileExtension, Outcome
| order by Events desc
content.title: Attachment Protect by File Type

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType == "ttp_url"
| extend Action = tostring(Body.action)
| summarize Events = count() by Action
content.title: URL Protect Actions

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType == "ttp_url"
| extend Category = tostring(Body.category)
| where isnotempty(Category)
| summarize Events = count() by Category
| order by Events desc
content.title: URL Categories

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType == "ttp_url"
| project TimeGenerated, User = tostring(Body.userEmailAddress), Sender = tostring(Body.fromUserEmailAddress), Url = tostring(Body.url), Action = tostring(Body.action), ScanResult = tostring(Body.scanResult), Route = tostring(Body.route), CreationMethod = tostring(Body.creationMethod), Definition = tostring(Body.ttpDefinition), Category = tostring(Body.category)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: URL Protect Events

content.query:
MimecastEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by mimecastEventId
| where mimecastEventType in ({EventType})
| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType == "ttp_impersonation"
| extend Definition = tostring(Body.definition), Action = tostring(Body.action)
| summarize Events = count() by Definition, Action
| order by Events desc
content.title: Impersonation Protect by Definition and Action

content.query:

| extend Body = todynamic(mimecast_body)
| where mimecastEventType == "ttp_impersonation"
| project TimeGenerated, Sender = tostring(Body.senderAddress), Recipient = tostring(Body.recipientAddress), Subject = tostring(Body.subject), Definition = tostring(Body.definition), Hits = toint(Body.hits), Identifiers = tostring(Body.identifiers), Action = tostring(Body.action), TaggedMalicious = tostring(Body.taggedMalicious), SenderIp = tostring(Body.senderIpAddress)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
